files.body:
Version 2 is planned to expand the protocol beyond the current `Ping` message with additional message types, more robust decoding and validation, and clearer compatibility guarantees for future clients and servers; the work will preserve the existing ping round-trip behavior while establishing a foundation for versioned protocol evolution.

Shipped: v2 `Hello` messages, encoded as `v:2|hello:<name>` with matching decode support and round-trip behavior.
